name: SUPERLN
recent: Superlon 在 2026 年 9 月公布季度业绩，营收与净利均大幅增长，并任命 Jeremy Liu 为首席执行官。公司持续在公开市场回购股份，同时大股东 Liu Lee, Hsiu-Lin 获股东大会批准豁免因回购而触发的强制全面收购义务。
notable: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度净利达 547.6 万令吉，营收 3922.6 万令吉，创下十年新高。
任命 Jeremy Liu 为首席执行官。
股东大会通过豁免 Liu Lee, Hsiu-Lin 及其一致行动人因公司回购股份而触发强制全面收购的义务。
risks: 董事在闭窗期内有交易公司证券的意向。
公司持续回购股份可能影响公众持股比例及股权结构。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度（截至 7 月 31 日）营收为 3922.6 万令吉，环比增长 23.8%，同比增长 17.0%；净利为 547.6 万令吉，环比增长 68.5%，同比增长 150.8%；净利率从上一季度的 10.3% 提升至 14.0%。

recent_en: Superlon reported strong quarterly earnings growth in September 2026 and appointed Jeremy Liu as CEO.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 reached RM5.476 million on revenue of RM39.226 million, a decade-high.
Appointed Jeremy Liu as Chief Executive Officer.
risks_en: Directors indicated intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM39.226 million, up 23.8% QoQ and 17.0% YoY; net profit was RM5.476 million, up 68.5% QoQ and 150.8% YoY; net margin improved to 14.0% from 10.3% in the previous quarter.
